reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at 185 seats. It was signed 2025-08-19 and took effect 2025-09-01.

- **Her own correction agrees:** in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 she first posted 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later.
- **What she may need for the deck:** Amendment No. 3 was signed 2026-09-22 and raises the count to 230, but not until 2027-01-01. I told her 185 is still the current count.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, and Dana is on the North team, so no approval was needed. I only gave her seat counts and dates, not the per-seat price or discount that appear elsewhere in the account records.
